Subject: RE: Supplier portal invite — link accepts then returns to login (Coupa)

Marking initial triage notes here.

What I suspect: cookie chaining + proxy rewrite on the customer side causes the session cookie set by Coupa to be dropped on the final redirect back to the invite flow. Symptoms match: successful SSO, then landing page shows unauthenticated state and an inert Accept button.

Immediate remediation steps we can try (one of these should restore acceptance quickly):
1) Ask Aurum to open the invite in an incognito window (temporary workaround).
2) Reissue the invite from the console with a fresh short-lived token (we can regenerate on their vendor record).
3) As an infra hotfix, set the edge response cookie flags for the invite flow to SameSite=None; Secure and ensure Set-Cookie headers aren't being stripped by our CDN.

Data I need from Aurum to confirm: host header, the exact invite URL (token), and the accept button trace output. If they can capture a HAR that includes the redirect chain that will be ideal.

I've created SUP-4321 and assigned to eng-ops for the cookie header tweak. See: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/SUP-4321

—Ben Carter
